name: qyl-mcp-server
description: qyl telemetry MCP Apps server: trace explorer and MCP dashboard for a live collector or explicit demo mode

scripts.clean: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-test', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode mcp-app && vite build --mode mcp-dashboard && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && node -e "require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/main.js', 0o755)"
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/*.test.js
